title: How a Fractional CMO scaled to 8 clients
subhead: A seasoned Fractional CMO went from managing 3 overwhelmed clients to running marketing strategy for 8 high-growth companies.
challenge: Constantly switching between client communication channels, project tools and marketing platforms, losing strategic thinking time to every context switch.
60% of his time went to status updates and progress reports instead of the high-impact strategy clients were paying for.
Every client had different internal teams and approval processes, so he became the bottleneck manually coordinating his own vision with client execution teams.
Already at capacity with 3 clients, with no way to take on the higher-value work he was positioned to win.

solution.title: One command center for every client
Standardized handoff templates for every campaign
Automated dashboards instead of manual reporting

quote: Handoff didn't just solve my operational challenges. It transformed my entire business model. I went from being a stressed consultant juggling 3 clients to a strategic advisor confidently serving 8 high-growth companies. The ROI was immediate and continues to compound as I scale.
